design.neuralReset: once per 96-round sequence, not at strategy switches
design.message: bit=1 iff Q[cue] > max(other Q), tie 0
design.neuralSchedule: 680ms; cue 150Hz 0-240ms, count reset 50ms, frozen Q and bit 240ms, idle 240-680ms; no reward or dopamine
design.decoder: per-cue bit-to-mapping majority on sequence 53000 only, ties A
design.shuffle: one within-cue heldout Fisher-Yates bit shuffle, rng(2026110507)
design.gates: integrity; calibration each bit>=4/cue; heldout each mapping>=15/cue; heldout balanced>=80%/cue and +10pp over cue-only/shuffle, +20pp over untrained; every block>=75%, post-switch late12>=75%

limitation: One A-trained frozen teacher, two dependent continuous 96-round sequences; no teacher reward adaptation or student receiving/learning.
